subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Week 2: /n/ (nap, nip, pin, tin); differentiates i and n; segments oral sentences into words

show.line: Listen. n, n, nap. n, n, net! Nap starts with n.

rounds.prompt: Which one starts with n, as in nap?
Say the sound with me. n, as in nap!
Listen. p, i, n. What word is it?
Listen. t, i, n. What word is it?
Is it i or n? Listen. Nip.

hints: Put your tongue up and hum. n, n, n.
Listen for n at the start or at the end.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word that ends with n.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Tip ends with p. Tin ends with n.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. t, i, n. Tin ends with n!

parent_line: Can hear the n sound and blend words like pin, tin and nap.
